verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents Scheduling Links that let others book time across one or many calendars. Priority can be set per Scheduling Link, which implies you can keep several links with their own settings. The evidence never shows per-link durations, locations, custom intake questions, or confirmation/approval rules. missing for 10: per-event-type duration configuration, location settings, custom booking questions, confirmation/approval rules, independent or hands-on corroboration
